title: Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine

result.label: Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine
result.statement: Constructs a compact subset of ℝ 9 that cannot be covered by ten sets of strictly smaller diameter, disproving Borsuk's covering assertion already in dimension nine. The example consists of rank-one orthogonal projectors onto lines in ℝ 4 , with the Frobenius metric.
